shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: individual cast concept portrait for the original fictional Broadway musical BOUNCE. Make ONE highly photorealistic cinematic editorial portrait, vertical 3:4 composition, waist-to-chest up, face clear and expressive in upper-middle, real adult anatomy, natural pores and individual texture, quiet fine film grain, 50mm portrait photography. This is an invented character, not a real actor or celebrity. Dark contemporary New York working environment softly out of focus, neutral soft key light makes eyes and skin readable, restrained colored practical light in the background and gentle rim only. Emotional tone warm, talented, lived-in, aspirational, never a glossy fashion advert. Cohesive ensemble campaign: charcoal background, true-to-life skin, grounded clothing. No text, captions, lettering, logos, watermarks, frames, collage, or other people.
